units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 63">Gen. R. s. 63</cite> never despise a low Roman <he>ולא בג׳ זעיר</he> (<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 8:4:15">Y. Ter. VIII, end, 46ᶜ</cite> <he>בחבר</he>) not even a low galearius.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9">Num. R. s. 9</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 3:14">Tosef. Sot. III, 14</cite>, v. <cite ref="O01386"><he>סָפַן</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 6:12">Ib. to VI, 12</cite> practiced in four trades a bather, a barber, <he>גליור וכ׳</he> (read <he>גלייר</he>) a soldier’s servant and a crier; a. e.—Pl. <he>גּוּלְיָירִין</he>.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 15:1">Pesik. R. s. 15</cite>; Pesik. Haḥod. p. 45ᵇ <he>גולרירין</he> (corr. acc.); <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 11">Num. R. s. 11</cite>; a. e. the subordinate divine messengers.—

<cite ref="Nazir 66b:2">Naz. 66ᵇ</cite> <he>גּוּלְיָירִים מתגרין וכ׳</he> the common soldiers begin the battle and the heroes (veteran soldiers) wind up with victory; <cite ref="Berakhot 53b:28">Ber. 53ᵇ</cite> <he>גוליירין</he> (Var. <he>גליורין</he>, corr. acc.).
